# Summary

**codx-junior** (https://github.com/gbrian/codx-junior) is an open-source, AI-powered developer assistant and project management tool built with Python, Vue.js, and Docker, supporting local LLMs, RAG-based knowledge indexing, and code generation.

The goal is to **secure EU funding** to sustain and grow the project, leveraging its open-source nature, AI capabilities, and alignment with EU digital sovereignty goals.

The **top funding opportunities** identified are: **NLnet NGI Zero/Restack** (rolling grants, €5K–€50K, best fit for open-source), **EIC Accelerator** (up to €2.5M grant + €10M equity), and **Digital Europe Programme** (AI adoption & digital transformation focus).

Key **events to target** include **FOSDEM** (Brussels, open-source showcase), **Web Summit** (Lisbon, investor pitching), and **Slush** (Helsinki, startup competition with up to €1M prize).

The recommended strategy is to **apply to NLnet immediately** (rolling deadlines), **build a consortium** for Horizon Europe/EIC Pathfinder, and **gain visibility** through open-source events while framing codx-junior as a privacy-first, EU digital sovereignty enabler.

# Summary

**codx-junior** (https://github.com/gbrian/codx-junior) is an open-source, AI-powered developer assistant and project management tool built with Python, Vue.js, and Docker, supporting local LLMs, RAG-based knowledge indexing, and code generation.

The goal is to **secure EU funding** to sustain and grow the project, leveraging its open-source nature, AI capabilities, and alignment with EU digital sovereignty goals.

The **top funding opportunities** identified are: **NLnet NGI Zero/Restack** (rolling grants, €5K–€50K, best fit for open-source), **EIC Accelerator** (up to €2.5M grant + €10M equity), and **Digital Europe Programme** (AI adoption & digital transformation focus).

Key **events to target** include **FOSDEM** (Brussels, open-source showcase), **Web Summit** (Lisbon, investor pitching), and **Slush** (Helsinki, startup competition with up to €1M prize).

The recommended strategy is to **apply to NLnet immediately** (rolling deadlines), **build a consortium** for Horizon Europe/EIC Pathfinder, and **gain visibility** through open-source events while framing codx-junior as a privacy-first, EU digital sovereignty enabler.
